readings.Aries: The force you bring to a problem reshapes the problem. Make sure you're reshaping it usefully. Let this one be easy.
readings.Taurus: Your care for the physical world — spaces, objects, bodies — is a form of love. Extend it inward. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Gemini: The idea you dismissed too quickly deserves another look. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Cancer: Something is about to feel better. Not because anything changed — because the feeling has run its course. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Leo: There is love in your life that is asking to be expressed more plainly. Try plain. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Virgo: Something you do automatically would astound someone else if they could see it. Notice your competence. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Libra: Your sense of fairness is exquisite. It is occasionally applied in situations where it doesn't belong. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Scorpio: What's beneath the anger is more interesting than the anger. Go there. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Sagittarius: Your optimism is accurate. It is also sometimes premature. Check the current conditions. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Capricorn: There is a relationship in your life that has been managed rather than inhabited. Try inhabiting it. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Aquarius: Something about the way you've been living is about to change. You've known this for a while. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Pisces: The escape you're planning will not be there when you return. What would it mean to be here instead? Saying less will move this further than saying more.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
